Not yet. Tracking can take up to 24 hours to update, and our threshold for action is **4 business days** with no movement, so 3 days is just short of that. If it still hasn't moved after the 4th business day, contact us and we'll open a courier investigation, which takes up to 5 business days. If the package is found to be lost, you can choose a free replacement or a full refund.

The same applies if tracking shows delivered but nothing arrived. Also, if a weather hold was emailed to you, that could explain the delay, since live plants may be held up to 7 days when transit forecasts are below 35°F or above 95°F.
